sentence: This project studies how certain mutations relate to heart, lung or kidney disease in people with sickle cell disease.
This project studies how intracortical implants lead to inflammation and cell death through the innate immune response.
This project studies how dietary fiber intake relates to physical frailty and mild cognitive impairment in older adults.
This project studies how genetic variants relate to perinatal health by combining patient information over time with fetal sequencing data.
This project studies whether chronic distress changes blood metabolites in ways that link to poorer health as people age.
This project studies genes from families with inherited early-onset osteoarthritis and uses mouse models to find pathways that affect osteoarthritis risk.
This project builds a photothermal imaging method to measure metabolites inside cancer cells.
This project builds software that predicts adverse drug reactions in patients taking two or more prescription drugs, including opioids.
This project studies how neurons sense and detoxify reactive oxygen species and how this relates to Parkinson's Disease.
This project builds fluorescence lifetime imaging devices that help diagnose tissue and guide surgery in real time.
This project tries to find out why some patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors have cutaneous immune-related adverse events.
This project tests a drug candidate for melanoma tumors that carry certain mutations.
This project supports cancer drug discovery and development, taking drugs from target identification to early-phase clinical trials.
This project studies a type of stem cell in the skin that can form myelin, using genomic analyses in mice.
This project uses virtual reality, electrophysiology and neuropsychological testing to study attention and auditory processing in children with autism.
This project builds statistical methods that make it easier for researchers to analyze single-cell data.
This project tests whether gene therapy using a small protein that rescues calcium defects can treat heart failure and muscular dystrophy.
This project studies how kinesin motor proteins are switched off by kinesin binding protein and kinesin light chain.
This project studies how sphingosine-1-phosphate transporters work, using a suite of integrated biophysical methods.
This project studies how potassium dysregulation affects podocyte survival in glomerular disease.
